assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE 1000x760 landscape game-card ARTWORK only. Of the last 3 images: first is USER'S STRICT Eochaid pose/action reference (naked mannequin, red flying sword), second is ONLY Wylder armor/helmet/straight sword identity, third is ONLY flat graphic color-block style. Replace mannequin in first with Wylder while keeping exact pose: medium-close SIDE/REAR three-quarter figure hunched and twisting, head looking DOWN-LEFT, torso centered lower half, hips turned right, knees spread/staggered low at bottom edge. Exactly TWO empty gloved hands, NO hand holds any weapon: anatomical RIGHT shoulder at screen-left near viewer, right arm extends down-left, elbow slightly bent, open right palm near bottom-left. Anatomical LEFT shoulder at upper-right, left elbow lifted and bent, left forearm crosses IN FRONT of helmet toward lower-left, open left hand near center-left, like first reference. Coherent shoulder/elbow/wrist/palm chains, no extra hand. Wylder has closed SILVER FEATHER-WING HELMET, dark metal visor, black scarf, navy split skirt with sparse WHITE flowing ornament, grouped silver scales, brown leather gloves; simplify all metal engraving. ONE straight greatsword flies by telekinesis in UPPER-RIGHT, no hand touches it. Navy grip and sculptural OPEN FORKED silver pommel toward mid-upper-right, compact guard then broad STRAIGHT steel blade pointing to upper-right corner; pommel/grip/guard/blade axis are one ruler-straight diagonal. Sword remains visibly steel, NOT a curved energy ribbon. A powerful SCARLET RED wide diagonal trail runs from lower-left behind the torso to upper-right around flying sword, narrow pale-red helical ribbons tightly spiral around blade's longitudinal axis, showing spinning thrust. This is one sword rotating/advancing, not multiple swords or hand-swing attack. Keep BOTH open hands readable and separate from trail. Background LIGHT warm grey/ivory quiet negative fields, one broad muted charcoal shadow shape below; no dark-blue jagged wallpaper, no white storm crescents, no fiery explosion, no flame tongues. Finite palette navy/silver/brown, SCARLET and pale grey; black shapes define torso/arms. Graphic flat 2D fantasy card art, chunky silhouettes, large clean color blocks, 2-3 HARD-EDGED CEL planes per material, exaggerated perspective, no photo texture, intricate scales, cinematic lighting or painterly rendering. Single clear event: empty-handed Wylder remotely sends a red-spiraling flying sword diagonally forward. No text/UI/frame, no sword in either hand, no naked person, no second weapon, no floating disembodied hands.
